source: Objetivos conferidos no poedb.tw (Covens challenges); recompensas no fórum oficial da GGG

challenges.name: Orbs básicas
challenges.description: Use Transmutation, Augmentation, Alteration e Alchemy (a bancada de craft também conta).

challenges.name: Primeiros passos na Covens
challenges.description: Mate um monstro único com pelo menos 1 Fate e coloque uma Viscera no Wickerman.
parts: Kill a Unique Monster empowered by at least 1 Fate
Place a Viscera in your Wickerman

challenges.name: Receitas de vendedor I
challenges.description: Receba pelo vendedor (por receita, não comprando): Life Flask, Mana Flask, anel e amuleto básicos.

challenges.name: Chefes dos atos 1 a 5
challenges.description: Derrote Merveil, Vaal Oversoul, Dominus, Malachai e Kitava (ato 5).

challenges.name: Panteão com Fate
challenges.description: Derrote os 8 deuses do Panteão com pelo menos 1 Fate.

challenges.name: Wickerman completo
challenges.description: Tenha uma Viscera em todos os slots do Wickerman.

challenges.name: Chefes dos atos 6 a 10
challenges.description: Derrote Brine King, Arakaali, Lunaris e Solaris, Depraved Trinity e Kitava (ato 10).
parts: Act 8: Lunaris, Eternal Moon and Solaris, Eternal Sun

challenges.name: Mecânicas de liga I
challenges.description: Faça 5 destes encontros o número de vezes pedido (30 cada).
parts: Have Sacred Flora spread Wisps x30

challenges.name: Mecânicas de liga II
challenges.description: Faça 5 destes encontros o número de vezes pedido.
parts: Complete Unstable Breaches or Hives x30
Complete Immortal Syndicate Member Encounters x80

challenges.name: Chefes únicos com Fate
challenges.description: Derrote 50 chefes de mapa únicos com Fate.

challenges.name: Atlas completo
challenges.description: Complete todos os mapas não-únicos do Atlas.

challenges.name: Mecânicas de endgame
challenges.description: Faça 5 destes encontros de endgame o número de vezes pedido.
parts: Claim rewards from Rare Maps successfully completed by your Atlas Runners x30
Activate Apparition or Evolving Shrines x10
Defeat an Essence Monster that has at least 1 of the following Essences: Hysteria, Horror, Delirium, Insanity
Defeat Bosses from Sacred Flora in Maps x3

challenges.name: Encontros nível 81+
challenges.description: Faça 5 destes encontros em área nível 81 ou mais, o número de vezes pedido.
parts: Complete all Rituals in Maps with at least one Blood-filled Vessel applied x10
Defeat Queen Atziri in the Temple of Atzoatl x5
Complete Logbooks with at least 10 Remnants active x5
Complete Hive Fortresses or defeat Breach Marshals x5
Domains of Timeless Conflict with at least 25 reward crystals shattered x3
Complete Blighted or Blight Ravaged Maps x5

challenges.name: 400 tiers de Fate
challenges.description: Mate chefes únicos de mapas vermelhos somando 400 tiers de Fate invocados.

challenges.name: Orbs avançadas
challenges.description: Use 12 destas currencies (a bancada de craft também conta).

challenges.name: Quatro Voidstones
challenges.description: Encaixe as 4 Voidstones no Atlas.

challenges.name: Ascendência
challenges.description: Use o Ascendancy Device nos 4 Labirintos e ganhe uma Bloodline Class.
parts: Use the Ascendancy Device in the Labyrinth
Use the Ascendancy Device in the Cruel Labyrinth
Use the Ascendancy Device in the Merciless Labyrinth
Use the Ascendancy Device in the Eternal Labyrinth

challenges.name: Recompensas de Fate
challenges.description: Derrote chefes com Fate e receba 10 destes tipos de recompensa o número de vezes pedido.

challenges.name: Cartas de adivinhação
challenges.description: Abra 100 Stacked Decks e entregue 50 sets de Divination Cards.
parts: Turn in Divination Card Sets x50

challenges.name: Receitas de vendedor II
challenges.description: Receba pelo vendedor: mapa tier 16, item único, item com influência e Exalted Orb.

challenges.name: Mirage
challenges.description: Faça 3 destes encontros de Mirage.
parts: Choose Wishes with Sigils of Navira x10
Choose Wishes with Sigils of Ruzhan x10
Choose Wishes with Sigils of Kelari x10
Defeat Map Bosses in Miraged Areas x50
Defeat Saresh, of the Weeping Black

challenges.name: Viscera variadas
challenges.description: Coloque 8 destas Visceras no Wickerman.

challenges.name: Mapas únicos
challenges.description: Complete 15 destes mapas únicos.

challenges.name: Mil Threads
challenges.description: Complete mapas somando 1000 Threads aplicados.

challenges.name: Corrupção
challenges.description: Faça 3 destas tarefas de corrupção.
parts: Turn in Divination Card Sets that reward Corrupted Items x15

challenges.name: Fates tier 3
challenges.description: Derrote chefes de mapa T16 com 100%+ de Atlas Drops invocando 10 destes Fates tier 3.

challenges.name: Mecânicas misturadas
challenges.description: Faça 6 destes encontros de conteúdo de liga.
parts: Defeat a Rare Sacred Fauna fertilised by Ritual ground
Defeat an Architect while affected by a Tempest
Defeat a Breach Marshal while Delirious
Defeat a Legion General that has been tagged by a Sentinel
Defeat a Syndicate member while affected by a Shrine
Capture a Beast holding an Essence
Defeat a Chaplain of the Well

challenges.name: Chefes e encontros
challenges.description: Derrote 7 destes chefes ou encontros.
parts: It That Was Tul and It That Was Esh

challenges.name: Anomalias do Atlas
challenges.description: Complete 30 Atlas Anomalies.

challenges.name: Mapas raros com Fate
challenges.description: Derrote o chefe final de 12 destes mapas raros T16, com 100%+ de Atlas Drops e Fate tier 3.

challenges.name: 25.000% de Atlas Drops
challenges.description: Some 25.000% de Atlas Drops completando mapas.

challenges.name: Eldritch
challenges.description: Faça 2 destes encontros Eldritch o número de vezes pedido.
parts: Activate Eater of Worlds Altars x250

challenges.name: Árvore do Atlas cheia
challenges.description: Aloque todos os 150 pontos da árvore do Atlas.

challenges.name: Pinnacles com Grim Fate
challenges.description: Derrote 5 destes chefes pinnacle com os Grim Fates invocados.

challenges.name: Mapas de Originator
challenges.description: Some 300 modificadores explícitos completando mapas com influência de Originator.

challenges.name: Threads concentrados
challenges.description: Complete mapas raros T14+ com 100%+ de Atlas Drops e 8 Threads de um só tipo, em 5 destes tipos.

challenges.name: Mapas Nightmare
challenges.description: Complete 3 destes mapas Nightmare (T17) 5 vezes cada.

challenges.name: Coven Queen
challenges.description: Derrote a Coven Queen de 3 destas formas.
parts: Without being affected by more than 4 stacks of Corpserot
Without being affected by Blackfire or Blackfire Tornado
Without being hit by Crowstorm Vortex
Without being hit by Blackfire Detonation

challenges.name: Ubers com Grim Fate
challenges.description: Derrote 3 destes pinnacles em área nível 85 com os Grim Fates invocados.

challenges.name: Desafios finais
challenges.description: Faça 4 destes encontros o número de vezes pedido.
parts: Use the Divine Font in the Endgame Labyrinth x50
Complete Rare Shaper, Elder, Conqueror or Memory Guardian Maps with at least 100% Atlas Drops x50
Complete Rare Tier 16 Maps with at least 8 applied Threads of any League Mechanic. Maps with multiple sets of 8 Threads will count multiple times towards this Challenge. x150
Defeat Level 83 or higher Rare monsters with at least 6 modifiers x100
Defeat Map Bosses in Rare Tier 16 Maps that have been Empowered by a Tier 3 Fate x100
